entries.PRT-QL-071: {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for the same period in {business}. If {partnerA}'s profit share was {knownShare}, how much profit did {partnerB} receive?
entries.PRT-QL-072: In {business}, {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested for the same period and received profit shares of {shareA} and {shareB}. Find the ratio of their capitals.
entries.PRT-QL-073: {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for the same period in {business}. The business suffered a loss of {totalLoss}. How much of the loss should {targetPartner} bear?
entries.PRT-QL-074: {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested a total capital of {totalCapital} for the same period in {business}. Their profit ratio was {profitRatioA}:{profitRatioB}. Find {partnerA}'s capital.
entries.PRT-QL-075: In {business}, {partnerA} invested some capital for {durationA}, while {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for {durationB}. If both received equal profit, find {partnerA}'s capital.
entries.PRT-QL-076: In {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} for some time, while {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for {durationB}. If both received equal profit, for how long did {partnerA} invest?
entries.PRT-QL-077: {partnerA} invested {capitalA} for {durationA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for {durationB} in {business}. If total profit was {totalProfit}, find the difference between their profit shares.
entries.PRT-QL-078: In a one-year {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} from the beginning but left after {leaveAfterA}. {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for the full year. Find their profit-sharing ratio.
entries.PRT-QL-079: In a one-year {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} from the beginning. {partnerB} joined after {joinAfterB} with {capitalB}. If total profit was {totalProfit}, find {targetPartner}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-080: In a one-year {business}, {partnerA} invested an unknown capital and left after {leaveAfterA}. {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for the full year. If their profit ratio was {profitRatioA}:{profitRatioB}, find {partnerA}'s capital.
entries.PRT-QL-081: In a one-year {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} from the start, {partnerB} joined after {joinAfterB} with {capitalB}, and {partnerC} joined after {joinAfterC} with {capitalC}. If {targetPartner}'s profit share was {knownShare}, find the total profit.
entries.PRT-QL-082: {partnerA} started a one-year {business} with {initialCapitalA} and decreased the capital by {percentageDecreaseA}% after {changeMonthA}. {partnerB} kept {capitalB} invested throughout. Find their profit ratio.
entries.PRT-QL-083: {partnerA} started a one-year {business} with {initialCapitalA} and {fractionalChangeA} after {changeMonthA}. {partnerB} kept {capitalB} invested throughout. Find their profit ratio.
entries.PRT-QL-084: {partnerA} started a one-year {business} with {initialCapitalA} and later changed the capital to {finalCapitalA}. {partnerB} kept {capitalB} invested throughout. If total profit was {totalProfit} and {partnerA}'s share was {knownShare}, after how many months did {partnerA} change the capital?
